tasks.label: Register API Service Client
tasks.command: mkdir -p "${workspaceFolder}/.local" && go run ./cmd/swctl auth ensure-service-client --auth-host "${env:SWAYRIDER_DEBUG_AUTHSERVICE_HOST}" --auth-port "${env:SWAYRIDER_DEBUG_AUTHSERVICE_GRPC_PORT}" --user "${env:SWAYRIDER_ADMIN_EMAIL}" --password "${env:SWAYRIDER_ADMIN_PASSWORD}" --output "${workspaceFolder}/.local/swayrider-api.env" swayrider-api region:query routing:execute search:execute tiles:serve
